description: A base class for services implementing Hono APIs, providing request handling via Vert.x event bus with OpenTracing support.

classes.name: EventBusService
classes.description: Abstract base class for Hono API services, handling request routing via Vert.x event bus with OpenTracing integration.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Sets the OpenTracing tracer; defaults to NoopTracer if not provided.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the service, registers event bus consumer, and calls doStart.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform startup tasks; default completes immediately.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Abstract method to specify the event bus address for incoming requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unregisters consumer and performs shutdown procedures.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform shutdown tasks; default completes immediately.

methods.name: registerConsumer
methods.description: Registers a Vert.x event bus consumer for handling requests.

methods.name: processRequestMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming request messages, extracts span context, processes request, and sends response.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Abstract method to process a service request; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getTypesafeValueForField
methods.description: Retrieves a property of a specific type from a JsonObject.

methods.name: removeTypesafeValueForField
methods.description: Removes and returns a property of a specific type from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getRequestPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload, adding 'enabled=true' if not present.

methods.name: finishSpanOnFutureCompletion
methods.description: Completes an OpenTracing span when a Future<EventBusMessage> completes, setting tags based on outcome.
